(4) Product detail page 'Message Seller' button: opens the message dialog but shows a disabled 'Log in to message' button instead of redirecting to /login (different UX than Add to Cart, though it does block sending). (5) Direct navigation to /cart while logged out: renders a completely blank page (only notification regions, no header/nav/content, no redirect to /login and no message).
